description:
Check whether a PDF conforms to PDF/A, the ISO archiving standard, with veraPDF.

Input: `pdf_base64` is the PDF as base64, at most 4 MB decoded; or pass the
file as a download link in `file`. `profile` picks the PDF/A part and level.

Returns `compliant` (true or false), `profile_name` (the profile veraPDF
used), `statement`, `passed_rules`, `failed_rules` and `top_failed_rules`:
up to 10 failed rules with their `id` (clause and test number),
`specification`, `description` and `failed_checks`. A file that is not a PDF
fails with `not_a_pdf`; an unavailable veraPDF with `engine_unavailable`.
For the full report in JSON, XML or HTML, use the REST API
(`POST /v1/verapdf/api/validate/{profile}`).

Credits: 2 per call.

file.description: The file as a download link, instead of `pdf_base64`. In ChatGPT, pass the user's uploaded file here. Other clients can set `download_url` to a public https URL.

download_url.description: A public https URL of the file.

file_id.description: An identifier for the file. ChatGPT sets it; other clients may pass any label, such as the file name.

pdf_base64.description: The PDF, base64-encoded. At most 4 MB decoded.

profile.description: The PDF/A part and level, such as "2b" or "3a". "auto" (the default) checks against the part the file declares, and against PDF/A-1b when it declares none.

name: validate_pdfa
title: Validate a PDF against PDF/A
